description: This file contains interface definitions for Orleans grains, specifically for a stateless worker grain that can interleave tasks and an observer interface for callbacks.

methods.name: GoSlow
methods.description: Initiates a slow execution task, accepting a callback observer.

methods.name: GoFast
methods.description: Initiates a fast execution task, accepting a callback observer.

methods.name: WaitAsync
methods.description: Waits asynchronously, likely for completion or notification.
